feed.title: Kwiyandikisha kuri kalendari
feed.body: Shyira gahunda z'umuryango wawe kuri kalendari ya telefoni yawe. Igaragaza ikigo, serivisi, isaha na kode gusa.
feed.once: Rikoporore ubu: rigaragara rimwe gusa. Ufite iri huza wese abona amasaha ya gahunda zawe.
feed.since: Birakora kuva {{day}}. Ushaka irindi huza, bizimye hanyuma ubyongere ubifungure.
feed.failed: Ntibishobotse guhindura ihuza rya kalendari. Ongera ugerageze.
